meta.title: Enterprise Transformation Portfolio
meta.subtitle: Programme Delivery & Transformation Overview
meta.notes: transformationAreas, technologyGroups and the optional per-project 'attention' summary are presentation groupings derived from the workbook's Domain, Technology / Platforms and RAG Commentary columns; all other project fields are taken directly from the workbook. Project milestones and the programme status summary (data/portfolio-status.json) are illustrative demo content aligned to each project's scope, dates and RAG commentary.

projects.scope: Migrate IGA to a cloud operating model, strengthen identity lifecycle management, integrations, governance and access reviews.
projects.ragCommentary: On track against the current baseline; no material delivery issues reported.

milestones.name: SailPoint ISC Design Approved
milestones.description: Target IGA architecture, Entra ID and SAP E1 integration patterns and migration approach approved by the design authority.

milestones.name: Priority Applications Onboarded
milestones.description: First wave of priority business applications onboarded to SailPoint ISC through REST API connectors, with joiner-mover-leaver flows live.

milestones.name: Cloud Migration Complete
milestones.description: Legacy IGA decommissioned, access reviews running on SailPoint ISC and operational handover to BAU completed.

projects.scope: Transform PAM to a cloud operating model, including JIT privileged access, session control and secrets management.
projects.ragCommentary: On track against the current baseline; no material delivery issues reported.

milestones.name: CyberArk Cloud Design Approved
milestones.description: CyberArk Privilege Cloud tenancy, vault design and Entra ID integration approved.

milestones.name: JIT Access Pilot Complete
milestones.description: Just-in-time privileged access, MFA and session recording piloted with infrastructure administration teams.

milestones.name: Privileged Accounts Migrated
milestones.description: Tier-0 and tier-1 privileged accounts onboarded, secrets vaulted and the legacy PAM service retired.

projects.scope: Phase I: replace the enterprise SIEM. Phase II: introduce security automation, response orchestration and enhanced detection use cases.
projects.ragCommentary: On track. Phase I platform replacement and Phase II automation are aligned under a single transformation roadmap.

milestones.name: SIEM Platform Design Approved
milestones.description: Target SIEM platform, priority log sources and data retention model approved.

milestones.name: Phase I: SIEM Cutover
milestones.description: Priority log sources onboarded, detections mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and the legacy SIEM switched off.

milestones.name: Phase II: SOAR Automation Live
milestones.description: Automated triage and response playbooks integrated with SOC tooling through APIs.

projects.projectName: Enterprise Directory Transformation – AD to Entra ID, Phase I
projects.scope: Deliver Phase I of the transformation from traditional Active Directory towards a cloud identity model and reduce dependency on on-premises directory services.
projects.ragCommentary: Legacy application dependencies and hybrid identity complexity are affecting migration sequencing; remediation plan is in progress.

milestones.name: Hybrid Identity Assessment Complete
milestones.description: Legacy application dependencies on Active Directory and Group Policy catalogued and migration sequence proposed.

milestones.name: Conditional Access & FIDO2 Baseline Live
milestones.description: Conditional Access policies, MFA and FIDO2 enforced in Entra ID for pilot user groups.

milestones.name: Phase I Migration Complete
milestones.description: Priority workloads authenticating through Entra ID and Entra PIM live for administrative roles. Sequencing affected by legacy application dependencies.

projects.scope: Segment the enterprise network, redesign security zones, rationalise firewall policies and reduce legacy network dependencies.
projects.ragCommentary: Firewall rule complexity and site-specific dependencies require additional remediation before full segmentation can be completed.

milestones.name: Segmentation Design Approved
milestones.description: Target security zones, VLAN model and firewall policy standards approved.

milestones.name: Pilot Sites Segmented
milestones.description: Segmentation and NAC deployed at pilot sites, with the firewall rulebase rationalised for the pilot scope.

milestones.name: Global Segmentation Complete
milestones.description: All in-scope sites segmented, SD-WAN routing aligned and legacy firewall rules retired. Depends on remediation of rule complexity and site-specific dependencies.

projects.projectName: IT Service Management Platform Transformation – ServiceNow to Jira SM
projects.scope: Migrate core ITSM capabilities from ServiceNow to Jira Service Management, covering Incident, Request, Change, Knowledge and Service Catalogue.
projects.ragCommentary: On track. Core process migration and service catalogue transition remain within the planned four-month delivery window.

milestones.name: Jira SM Configuration Complete
milestones.description: Incident, Request and Change workflows, Jira Assets CMDB model and service catalogue configured.

milestones.name: UAT Signed Off
milestones.description: Process owners sign off user acceptance testing and the ServiceNow data migration rehearsal.

milestones.name: ServiceNow to Jira SM Cutover
milestones.description: Go-live on Jira Service Management, with ServiceNow retained read-only for historical records.

projects.scope: Consolidate endpoint protection and EDR/XDR capabilities, improve hardening standards and retire legacy endpoint agents.
projects.ragCommentary: On track against the current baseline; no material delivery issues reported.

milestones.name: Defender & Intune Baseline Approved
milestones.description: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint policies and Intune hardening baselines approved.

milestones.name: Windows Estate Enrolled in Defender XDR
milestones.description: Majority of the Windows estate onboarded to Defender XDR with device compliance reporting.

milestones.name: Legacy Endpoint Agents Retired
milestones.description: Legacy antivirus and EDR agents removed and vulnerability management integrated into BAU.

projects.scope: Implement cloud security baselines, automated guardrails, posture management and compliance monitoring across strategic cloud platforms.
projects.ragCommentary: On track against the current baseline; no material delivery issues reported.

milestones.name: Cloud Security Baselines Approved
milestones.description: Azure and AWS security baselines mapped to ISO 27001 and NIS2 controls.

milestones.name: Policy as Code Guardrails Live
milestones.description: Terraform-based preventive guardrails deployed to production landing zones.

milestones.name: CSPM Monitoring Operational
milestones.description: Cloud posture management and compliance monitoring handed over to cloud operations.

projects.scope: Standardise application ownership, access certification, role models, segregation-of-duties controls and recurring access reviews.
projects.ragCommentary: On track against the current baseline; no material delivery issues reported.

milestones.name: Application Ownership Model Agreed
milestones.description: Named business and technical owners assigned for in-scope applications, including SAP E1.

milestones.name: Role Model & SoD Rules Released
milestones.description: Business roles and segregation-of-duties rules configured in SailPoint.

milestones.name: First Enterprise Recertification Complete
milestones.description: Enterprise-wide access certification campaign completed, with audit evidence retained.

projects.projectName: Zero Trust Access Transformation with Zscaler
projects.scope: Transform remote, administrative and third-party access towards identity-aware Zero Trust access and reduce reliance on traditional VPN.
projects.ragCommentary: On track against the current baseline; no material delivery issues reported.

milestones.name: ZPA / ZIA Architecture Approved
milestones.description: Zscaler ZPA and ZIA design, Entra ID Conditional Access and device posture checks approved.

milestones.name: Third-Party Access on ZPA
milestones.description: Vendor and third-party access moved from VPN to Zscaler ZPA application segments.

milestones.name: Legacy VPN Decommissioned
milestones.description: Remote and administrative access fully on Zscaler and legacy VPN concentrators retired.

projects.projectName: Machine Identity & Secrets Management – Discovery and Phase I
projects.scope: Perform enterprise discovery of service accounts, API keys and certificates, followed by Phase I onboarding and automated secrets rotation.
projects.ragCommentary: On track. Discovery scope is defined and Phase I onboarding criteria are being prepared.

milestones.name: Machine Identity Discovery Complete
milestones.description: Inventory of service accounts, API keys and certificates across priority platforms completed.

milestones.name: Vaulting & PKI Patterns Approved
milestones.description: CyberArk secrets vaulting and PKI certificate lifecycle patterns approved.

milestones.name: Phase I Onboarding & Rotation Live
milestones.description: Priority machine identities vaulted, with automated secrets rotation enabled.

projects.projectName: Global IT Operating Model & Process Transformation
projects.scope: Standardise global IT processes, ownership, governance, RACI, KPI, escalation models and the global/local operating model.
projects.ragCommentary: On track. Target operating model and process ownership principles are progressing to plan.

milestones.name: Target Operating Model Approved
milestones.description: Global/local operating model, RACI and governance forums approved by IT leadership.

milestones.name: Core ITIL Processes Redesigned
milestones.description: Standardised processes, KPIs, SLAs and escalation paths published and configured in Jira Service Management.

milestones.name: Operating Model Embedded
milestones.description: KPI reporting live and the continual improvement cycle handed to process owners.

projects.scope: Modernise the enterprise data platform, standardise data models, consolidate reporting and migrate legacy analytics to a modern architecture.
projects.ragCommentary: On track. Target data architecture and migration waves are aligned with the planned 2028 transformation roadmap.

milestones.name: Snowflake Foundation Ready
milestones.description: Production Snowflake environment, security model and core data integration framework available.

milestones.name: Semantic Layer Released
milestones.description: Governed semantic layer and data catalogue published, with the first Power BI reports on the new model.

milestones.name: Legacy Reporting Migration Complete
milestones.description: Legacy analytics and SAP E1 reporting migrated and the old reporting platform retired.

projects.projectName: Global CRM & Customer Experience Platform Transformation
projects.scope: Transform the CRM and customer experience platform, integrate customer data, modernise the frontend and deliver a phased market rollout.
projects.ragCommentary: CRM integration complexity and market rollout dependencies are under active review; delivery remains recoverable within the programme window.

milestones.name: CRM Solution Design Signed Off
milestones.description: Target CRM design, customer data model and SAP E1 / REST API integration approach signed off.

milestones.name: Pilot Market Go-Live
milestones.description: CRM platform and new customer frontend live in the pilot market with integrated customer data.

milestones.name: Phased Market Rollout Complete
milestones.description: Remaining markets migrated and legacy CRM decommissioned. Depends on resolving integration complexity and market rollout dependencies.

projects.projectName: New Call Centre Onboarding & Operational Readiness
projects.scope: Onboard a new call centre, covering office readiness, IT infrastructure, telephony/contact-centre capabilities, workplaces, CRM access, training and cutover.
projects.ragCommentary: Vendor delay in office fit-out and preparation of the call centre premises is impacting infrastructure installation, workplace readiness and planned onboarding dates.

milestones.name: Office Infrastructure Ready
milestones.description: Premises fit-out complete, with LAN/WAN and workplace infrastructure installed. Delayed by the vendor's office fit-out.

milestones.name: Technology & Telephony Ready
milestones.description: CCaaS, telephony/IVR, CRM access and end-user computing installed and tested on site. Dependent on premises readiness.

milestones.name: Operational Go-Live
milestones.description: Agents trained, cutover complete and the call centre handling live customer contacts. Planned onboarding dates under pressure.
